body_md:
These five HVAC companies have a Current, Active Florida contractor license, and the ownership notes used here show no parent company. Four list a West Palm Beach location; Mechanical Air Conditioning lists a Riviera Beach license address and includes West Palm Beach in its service area. License numbers, named people, hours, and service areas come from Florida DBPR licensee lookup, Florida filings, and company sites, with contacts checked on November 3, 2026.

## How we picked

Each company was checked for an HVAC contractor license with status Current, Active in the Florida DBPR licensee lookup, and for a named owner, president, or manager with no parent company shown. License type, number, status, licensure date, expiration, licensee name, DBA, and license address come from that DBPR record. Ownership, years stated by the company, service area, hours, and features come from the company site or the Florida filing named on the listing. Those facts link to each entry’s DBPR licensee detail page and company website. Contacts were checked on 2026-11-03.

## At a glance

- Four listings are Certified Air Conditioning Contractor licenses: Preferred Air Conditioning & Mechanical, LLC (CAC1817665), Mechanical Air Conditioning (CAC1816081), Prestige Air Conditioning Systems, Inc. (CAC1815452), and Alpha Mechanical Construction Solutions, LLC (CAC1816908). Lowen Air Conditioning is a Certified Mechanical Contractor license (CMC1250868). All five statuses are Current, Active, and each expiration listed is 08/31/2028.
- DBPR licensure dates are 04/30/2007 for Prestige Air Conditioning Systems, 12/17/2008 for Mechanical Air Conditioning, 09/07/2011 for Alpha Mechanical Construction Solutions, 11/19/2013 for Preferred Air Conditioning & Mechanical, and 11/13/2020 for Lowen Air Conditioning. Company-stated history is separate: Lowen started in 1971 and the site states more than 50 years; Preferred states family owned and operated since 1984; Mechanical Air Conditioning states more than 40 years; Prestige states 34 years serving Palm Beach County and also states over 30 years, with a Florida filing date of 03/03/1992; Alpha’s site states 80 years of experience, and its Florida LLC filing date is 08/17/2022.
- Service-area wording is not the same. Preferred lists West Palm Beach plus Boca Raton, Boynton Beach, Delray, Jupiter, Lake Worth, Loxahatchee, North Palm Beach, Palm Beach Gardens, Royal Palm Beach, Wellington, Stuart, Port St. Lucie, Ft. Pierce, and Vero Beach. Lowen lists Palm Beach County cities including West Palm Beach, Palm Beach Gardens, Jupiter, Wellington, Boca Raton, Boynton Beach, Delray Beach, Lake Worth, Lake Worth Beach, Lantana, Loxahatchee, North Palm Beach, Palm Beach, and Palm Springs. Mechanical Air Conditioning lists Palm Beach County and the Treasure Coast, including West Palm Beach. Prestige lists Palm Beach County cities on its site, including West Palm Beach. Alpha states South Florida.
- Preferred is a Carrier Factory Authorized Dealer. Lowen is a Trane Comfort Specialist since 1999. Mechanical Air Conditioning states it installs and repairs systems from any manufacturer. Prestige states it services all makes and models listed on the site. Alpha’s listing does not name a vendor brand.

## Things to know before you go

Match the city you need to the service-area list on that company’s site before you call, because the city lists are not identical. Hours differ as well. Preferred states technicians available 24 hours a day for emergency service, with office hours Monday–Friday 8:30AM–4:30PM. Lowen states a 24/7 answering service. Mechanical Air Conditioning states 24/7 emergency repairs. Prestige states emergency service Monday through Friday until 6PM and Saturday until 3PM, and closed Sundays.

Preferred, Lowen, and Mechanical Air Conditioning state NATE-certified technicians. Prestige states EPA certified, and licensed, bonded, and insured. Lowen states residential and light commercial work, plus parts, labor, and repair warranties. Alpha’s site states it is a local, family-owned and operated union mechanical and plumbing contractor, lists commercial HVAC, and states it is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business.

Pricing notes to ask about are also specific. Preferred and Lowen state flat-rate pricing. Preferred states a free service call with a repair, and states save up to $1,650 on new qualifying systems, call for details. Mechanical Air Conditioning states financing subject to approved credit. Prestige states financing available subject to approval, and lists maintenance agreements, duct cleaning, and ductless mini-splits.

Named people and street addresses are on the license or filing. Preferred’s licensee is Donald Wayne O’Bryon; the site names Donald O’Bryon as president, at 1643 Donna Rd, West Palm Beach. Lowen’s licensee is Philip J. Viruso II; the site states Phil Viruso took over in 2020, and the license address is 2405 Mercer Ave, West Palm Beach. Mechanical Air Conditioning’s licensee and named owner is Norm Sayre, at 8050 Monetary Drive, Riviera Beach. Prestige’s licensee and president is Scott Golloub, at 2610 Ridgeway Avenue, West Palm Beach. Alpha’s license qualifier is Rafael Cabrera Jr.; the Florida LLC filing lists Joanna Stevens as MGR/AMBR and Marc Stevens as AMBR. Alpha’s license address is 4926 Pine Ridge Lane, West Palm Beach, and its filing principal address is 15694 85th Rd N, Loxahatchee.

Phones on the listings are (561) 202-1422 for Preferred, (561) 935-6489 for Lowen, 561-848-6227 for Mechanical Air Conditioning, and (561) 833-8861 for Prestige. Each listing also includes the company website.

## FAQ

### Are these Florida HVAC licenses current?

Yes. Florida DBPR licensee lookup shows Current, Active for CAC1817665, CMC1250868, CAC1816081, CAC1815452, and CAC1816908. Each record lists an expiration of 08/31/2028.

### How is independent ownership shown here?

Each ownership note names a person and states that no parent company is shown. Those people are Donald O’Bryon, Phil Viruso, Norm Sayre, Scott Golloub, and Joanna Stevens and Marc Stevens. Preferred, Lowen, Mechanical Air Conditioning, and Alpha also have a company-site statement of family owned or family owned and operated.

### Do the listings use the same emergency hours and brands?

The listed hours and brands are not the same. Preferred states 24-hour emergency technicians, Lowen states a 24/7 answering service, and Mechanical Air Conditioning states 24/7 emergency repairs. Prestige states emergency service Monday through Friday until 6PM, Saturday until 3PM, and closed Sundays. Preferred names Carrier, and Lowen names Trane. Mechanical Air Conditioning states any manufacturer, and Prestige states all makes and models listed on its site.
